is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) and Anopheles funestus (s.l.) as malaria vectors in Mvoua, Cameroon.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for the Vgsc L1014F (kdr-west) mutation in An. gambiae and An. coluzzii (Table 2, page 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 on page 6 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and allele frequencies for the L1014F mutation in An. gambiae and An. coluzzii.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Mvoua, Cameroon, using field-collected mosquitoes (F1 progeny of field-caught larvae).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original empirical research study conducted between 2018 and 2019.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Mvoua village, Okola district, Central region, Cameroon (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The entomological survey was conducted from July 2018 to April 2019 (page 1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a specific, localized longitudinal survey in Mvoua village conducted in 2018-2019.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigated malaria vector biology, insecticide resistance, and LLIN effectiveness in Mvoua, Cameroon. It reports high resistance to pyrethroids in An. gambiae (s.l.) and a high frequency of the kdr-L1014F mutation (89.74% overall). Genotype counts for L1014F are provided for An. gambiae and An. coluzzii.
